inbox.subject: Boston: overnight recurrence, fix is in
inbox.body:
Alex,

The Boston handoff queue stalled again at 1:20am. Same root cause as Monday: the provider sync job retried in a loop and locked the handoff table. I've been on it all night with Wen's help on the agent side. Fix deployed at 4:40am, queue moving again. Backlog peaked at 164 handoffs overnight and is down to 58 as of now. About 3.2 hours of degraded service.

I want to keep the retry cap in place and add a second guard before we call it closed. Will walk everyone through it at 7am. Going to grab two hours of sleep after the bridge.

Sanjay

inbox.subject: Adjusted forecast
inbox.body:
Alex,

Updated the model last night. ARR dropped to $17.8M on the current run rate. Drivers: two Family cohorts churning after the Boston disruption, and one at Work renewal slipping into Q1. That puts the gap to the $19M year end plan at $1.2M, up from $1.0M.

I'd like to agree on how we show this on the board forecast slide in our 9am. I don't want to soften it.

Julian

inbox.subject: Out sick today
inbox.body:
Alex,

Tomás out sick today. Fever since last night, I'm not going to be useful. Sorry about the timing with Harborline at 2pm. My notes on Diane and Owen are in the shared folder, and Jordan knows the launch numbers. I'll check messages this evening if I can.

Tomás

inbox.subject: Two declines
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Difficult news. Lena Okafor declined the VP Care Operations offer this afternoon; she took a counter from her current employer. Marcus Delgado also declined the Director of Engineering role, citing relocation. With these two, the hiring slowdown is now 17% in active pipeline versus September, down from 15% last month.

I have three backup profiles for each role. Can we use our meeting this afternoon to decide whether to reopen both searches or revisit comp bands?

Best,
Grace
TalentBridge

inbox.subject: Capacity plan: need more time
inbox.body:
Alex,

I'm not going to have the January capacity plan ready for Friday. Boston ate the last two days and the Lena decline changes who owns care ops onboarding. I need until Tuesday to give you a real answer on whether we can take 1600 households into setup or should hold Harborline to 800 from January 1.

I'll cover the Harborline call at 2pm with you given Tomás is out.

Jordan

inbox.subject: Re: Partnership call today at 2pm
inbox.body:
Alex,

Confirming our partnership call today at 2pm. Owen Pryce from our benefits team will join. We'd like to understand the January launch plan for our 40,000 employees and how you'd handle activation above your assumptions.

Dialing in from the same bridge as last time.

Diane Coleridge
VP Benefits, Harborline Mutual

inbox.subject: Boston Thursday: itinerary
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

You're set to travel to Boston Thursday. Train leaves 6:58am, arrives 10:45am. Hotel is two blocks from the Boston office for Thursday night. Local team lunch 11am to 1pm. Partner meetings at 1pm and 3:30pm, Boston care team dinner at 6:30pm. Return train Friday 8:10am.

Let me know if you want me to add a visit with the Boston care leads in the morning.

Marisol

inbox.subject: Board pre-read
inbox.body:
Alex,

Checking on the board pre-read. Given Boston and the forecast movement, I'd rather see the hard numbers early than polished slides late. Friday works for me.

Helen

inbox.subject: last night
inbox.body:
I'm sorry about how last night went. I know the outage isn't your fault, but I felt like I was talking to your phone again. I stayed at Nina's so I could think.

I still want to go to Dr. Abernathy tonight at 6:30pm. Please be there and please don't be on email during it.

Sam

inbox.subject: Overnight incident: privacy check
inbox.body:
Alex,

Initial review shows no data exposure. The failure was a lock, not a leak. I'll have the log review done before our 4:30pm and a short note for the board deck.

Nadia

inbox.subject: Donna weekly update
inbox.body:
Hi Alex,

Quick weekly note on your mom. Donna's flu shot is confirmed for Saturday at her independent living residence. Pharmacy refill went through on time. Thursday's pedicure at Willow Lane is still not confirmed; they haven't found a tech who does diabetic foot care, so I'm holding the ride. Tommy is covering for me Friday if anything comes up.

Erika

inbox.subject: Evals review vs Harborline
inbox.body:
Alex,

I see the 2pm overlap. Happy to move evals to tomorrow or send you a written summary instead. Agent close rate held at 70 percent through the overnight.

Wen

inbox.subject: Elevator maintenance Thursday
inbox.body:
Tenants,

The east elevator bank will be out of service Thursday 7am to 11am for scheduled maintenance. Please use the west bank.

Facilities Desk, Brightwell Properties

inbox.subject: Board deck product section
inbox.body:
Alex,

I have three slides drafted on the partner portal and the Standing Plan. Still at 40 percent of provider confirmations in the portal. Will bring to 11am.

Priya

inbox.subject: Thanksgiving
inbox.body:
Hey,

Are you and Sam still coming to ours for Thanksgiving? Need a headcount by next week.

Sai
